entries.rationale: Documents prod_data_access=none (plan-issue 1.9.0) and clarifies that only reachability escalations always hand off, so projects without production access opt out explicitly instead of hitting an unverifiable hand-off on every new-state issue (ai-dossier#1216).

entries.anchor: Never run a bare `git worktree prune`.
entries.rationale: Phase 1 said a bare prune is always safe; it deleted the admin dirs of two renamed-but-unrepaired worktrees, corrupting both checkouts (ai-dossier#1232). The safe prune repairs every listed entry that still has a folder and prunes only what is truly gone.
